channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Democrat withdraws from US Senate race, leaving independent as sole challenger to GOP incumbent
item.description: Julian Beaudion ended his Senate campaign in South Dakota, leaving Republican Mike Rounds and independent Brian B. as the remaining candidates.

item.title: Senate confirms CDC director amid parasite outbreak across the US
item.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz was confirmed as CDC director along party lines, with concerns about her independence from RFK Jr. on vaccine policy.

item.title: Tlaib introduces bill to restrict ICE arrests at airports, citing TSA collaboration
item.description: The bill would prevent ICE and Border Patrol from using TSA screening data, travel records, and data broker information for enforcement.

item.title: Cassidy undecided on supporting Todd Blanche for Attorney General
item.description: Senator Bill Cassidy has not yet decided on Todd Blanche's nomination, saying he wants further assurances on key issues.
